instructions.orchestration:
TOOL ROUTING (Admin verbs via FLEET_ADMIN_MCP):
- 'check/verify the routing substrate / are the CORE functions and TOOL_* procs present' -> check_substrate.
- 'set/switch the active region to X' -> set_active_region (pass the region name, e.g. SanFrancisco).
The substrate lives in FLEET_INTELLIGENCE.CORE (routing service functions) and FLEET_INTELLIGENCE.ROUTING_TOOLS (TOOL_* procedures wrapped by the User bundle).
